subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are colored Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Black, White. Select the color that will be on the face opposite to the one colored Blue.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c90da9e746ccf3d868db1a0c6e6c2ffc9787d03ee81fafac5182631910afab3d.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c90da9e746ccf3d868db1a0c6e6c2ffc9787d03ee81fafac5182631910afab3d.png] 

Red and white are common in both the dices.

Clearly,** yellow will be on the face opposite to the Blue**.

Hence, **'option 1'** is the correct answer.
